nodes.text: My skin gets really oily by midday, especially on my forehead and nose, but my cheeks and the area around my mouth feel tight and flaky at the same time. I have inflamed pimples along my jawline and the skin around them is red and irritated. I think my harsh routine is part of the problem: I wash three times a day with a salicylic acid cleanser (Neutrogena Oil-Free Acne Wash) and use a benzoyl peroxide 10% spot treatment every night. Lately my skin stings when I apply anything. Fragranced toners make my face burn, and a clay mask left me with dry, red patches. I need something to calm the redness and fix the dryness without making me break out more.

My skin is combination: shiny T-zone but dry, flaky cheeks in winter. I have blackheads and clogged pores on my nose and chin that never seem to clear. I also have a few concerns that don't fit neatly into one category, like small bumpy texture on my forehead and occasional rough patches around my nose from wearing a mask all day. My routine is CeraVe Hydrating Cleanser in the morning, a glycolic acid toner a few times a week, and Cetaphil moisturizer at night. Heavy creams with coconut oil make my pores worse, and I broke out in an itchy rash once from a lavender-scented serum. I'd like help balancing everything out.

My skin is very dry, especially in cold weather, but I don't really have any specific problems like acne, redness or spots. I just want to keep it comfortable and healthy. I currently use a basic foaming face wash and a light lotion, and my face often feels a bit tight after washing. I'd like a simple routine that keeps my skin soft and maintained. I have no known allergies to products.

I'd say my skin is normal, not too oily or dry, but lately I've noticed dark spots on my cheeks left over from sun exposure last summer. My cheeks also get red and flushed easily, and in winter I get dry, flaky patches near my nose and chin. I use La Roche-Posay Toleriane cleanser, a vitamin C serum in the morning (The Ordinary Ascorbyl Glucoside), and SPF 30 when I remember. The vitamin C sometimes makes my cheeks feel hot and itchy. I want to fade the spots without irritating my skin or making the redness worse.

I have combination skin with an oily T-zone and normal cheeks. My main problems are persistent redness across my cheeks, dark marks left behind by old pimples, and new breakouts popping up around my chin. I've been using Paula's Choice 2% BHA exfoliant every day and a retinol serum three nights a week, which may be too much because my face looks blotchy. Fragrance-heavy products and apple cider vinegar toner caused burning and red welts in the past. I want to heal the post-acne marks and get the breakouts and redness under control.

I honestly don't know my skin type. Sometimes it feels oily, other times it's tight, and it changes with the weather. What bothers me most is the redness on my cheeks and around my nose, plus dark spots and uneven patches on my forehead and upper lip that have been there for a couple of years. I currently wash with plain water and use a drugstore moisturizer with SPF. I tried a niacinamide 10% serum and it made my skin flush and itch, and a hydroquinone cream I found online made the redness much worse. I'd love guidance on a gentle routine for spots and redness.

I get frequent breakouts with whiteheads and blackheads, mostly on my chin, forehead and nose, and my pores look clogged and enlarged. I'm not sure what skin type I have because it varies a lot. Right now I use a basic gel cleanser and sometimes pore strips, but the pimples keep coming back. I tried a thick coconut-oil-based moisturizer and it made my breakouts way worse. I also reacted badly to a sulfur mask with a lot of peeling. I need a routine that deals with acne and unclogs pores.

My skin is quite dry and often flaky, but I still get painful, deep pimples on my cheeks and jaw, especially around my period. It's confusing because most acne products dry me out even more. I use Cetaphil gentle cleanser and a thick moisturizer, and I tried Differin gel which caused a lot of peeling and tightness. Benzoyl peroxide wash bleached my towels and left my skin raw. I want an acne routine that won't destroy my already dry skin barrier.

I'm not sure if my skin is oily or dry, because it feels different every week. I have dark spots on my cheeks and temples that appeared after pregnancy, and the skin around them is often red and sensitive. Sunlight makes the dark spots darker and my face flushes easily. I currently use a gentle micellar water and Avene mineral sunscreen. Strong acids like glycolic peel pads left me with burning and visible redness, and a kojic acid serum gave me an itchy rash. I want to fade the pigmentation safely and reduce my redness.

I have no idea what my skin type is. My face is often red and blotchy, especially around my nose and cheeks, and I have lots of small clogged pores and blackheads on my nose and chin. My current routine is just a foaming cleanser and a random moisturizer from the drugstore. Scrubs with walnut shells make the redness flare up, and heavy foundations seem to clog my pores. Alcohol-based toners sting a lot. I'd like a gentle routine that soothes redness and helps clear the congestion.

I'm 34 and my skin is generally normal, but lately I get dry, flaky patches on my cheeks in winter. My cheeks also flush easily and look red after hot showers or wind. I have a few dark marks on my forehead from old sun exposure. I'm also noticing some fine lines around my eyes and my skin has become sensitive to fragranced products. Right now I use CeraVe Hydrating Cleanser, a basic Nivea moisturizer and sometimes a vitamin C serum, but the serum stings. Scented body lotions on my face make the redness worse.

My skin is combination: oily T-zone, normal to slightly dry cheeks. My main problems are the dark spots left over from old breakouts on my chin and jawline, and clogged pores on my nose that look like tiny blackheads. I use The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% and a gel cleanser from Neutrogena. I tried a strong scrub once and it made everything look worse, so I avoid physical exfoliants now. I'd like a routine that fades the marks and keeps my pores clear without drying out my cheeks.

I honestly don't know what my skin type is. It feels different depending on the season and what I use. I don't have any big problems, no breakouts or irritation to speak of, and I just want to start a simple routine. At the moment I only wash my face with water and sometimes use whatever moisturizer my sister gives me. I have no known allergies, so I'd like some guidance on a basic cleanser, moisturizer and sunscreen.

My skin is very dry and often feels tight after washing, but I also get painful pimples along my cheeks and chin, mostly around my period. I've tried benzoyl peroxide gel and it left my face feeling raw, so I'm cautious about strong actives. I currently use La Roche-Posay Toleriane cleanser and a thick Vanicream moisturizer. I need an acne approach that won't destroy my moisture barrier. Harsh foaming cleansers and alcohol-based toners are definitely off my list.

I'm 27 and not sure how to describe my skin type. Some days it's greasy, other days it's flaky. I keep getting inflamed pimples and whiteheads, plus clogged pores on my nose and chin. My skin also gets dry and peely around my mouth and nose. On top of that, I have constant sensitivity and a burning feeling when I apply new products, and I think my skin barrier is damaged from overusing a salicylic acid cleanser and a retinol I bought online. I used to use Clean & Clear scrub every day. Coconut oil broke me out badly, and so did a heavy foundation.

I have combination skin with a shiny forehead and normal cheeks. I don't have any particular skin concerns at the moment, just no breakouts or irritation. I want to maintain what I have and prevent problems later. My current routine is a gentle Cetaphil cleanser, a light gel moisturizer from Garnier and SPF 50 in the morning. I have no allergies that I know of and would just like advice on keeping things balanced.

My skin is normal most of the time, but I get hormonal acne on my chin and jawline a few times a month. The pimples leave stubborn dark spots that take months to fade, and the areas around them stay red and irritated. I use Paula's Choice 2% BHA twice a week and a plain moisturizer. Tea tree oil made my redness worse and picking at pimples definitely hasn't helped my dark marks. I want something that calms the redness and speeds up fading of the marks.

My skin is oily all over. By midday my face is shiny, and I need blotting papers. Surprisingly, I don't have real concerns beyond the shine: no acne, no dark spots, no redness. I use a foaming cleanser from Neutrogena and an oil-free gel moisturizer. I'd like to keep my skin healthy and learn whether a more mattifying sunscreen would help. I haven't had any bad reactions to products so far.

I'd say my skin is normal, but it's been acting up. I have clogged pores across my nose and forehead, regular breakouts with whiteheads and red pimples, and the dark spots they leave behind don't fade. At the same time my cheeks have become dry and tight, probably because I overuse a benzoyl peroxide wash and Differin gel. I use CeraVe moisturizing lotion at night. Heavy creams with shea butter clog my pores, and fragranced face masks made my skin itchy. I need a gentler routine that treats breakouts without drying me out.

My skin is combination: oily on my nose and forehead, but my cheeks get dry and rough, especially in colder weather. I have dark spots on my cheeks from sun exposure and old irritation that I would like to fade. I use a gentle cleanser by Bioderma, a vitamin C serum in the morning and a hyaluronic acid moisturizer. Glycolic acid toner left my cheeks flaky and tight, so I stopped using it. I'm looking for a routine that fades the dark spots while keeping my dry areas hydrated.

My skin is very dry and tight, especially on my cheeks and around my mouth, and it gets flaky by midday. I also get painful breakouts on my chin and jawline, and the skin around them stays red and irritated for days. I currently wash with a foaming cleanser (CeraVe Foaming) and use a benzoyl peroxide gel at night, which seems to make the dryness and redness worse. Salicylic acid toner stings and leaves my face blotchy. I need a gentle routine that treats pimples without stripping my skin.

I'm not sure what my skin type is because it changes with the seasons. I have dark marks left over from old pimples on my cheeks and forehead, and my face is often red and blotchy around the nose. My pores feel clogged, with blackheads on my nose and chin, and I still get a few active pimples every month. I also notice fine lines and rough texture on my forehead, which I did not expect at my age. I use a drugstore cleanser, Neutrogena moisturizer and sometimes a scrub, which probably irritates my skin more. Fragranced products make my face itchy.

My skin is combination: my T-zone gets shiny by noon but my cheeks feel dry and tight. I have blackheads and clogged pores on my nose and chin, and dark spots on my cheeks from sun exposure that have not faded in years. The dry patches on my cheeks get worse in winter. I use The Ordinary niacinamide and a light gel moisturizer, plus SPF when I remember. Vitamin C serums make my dry areas peel, so I'd like something gentler for the spots.

My skin is quite oily. My forehead and nose get shiny a couple of hours after washing, and my makeup slides around by afternoon. Otherwise I'm happy with it and have no real problems: no breakouts, no irritation, nothing that bothers me. I use a gel cleanser (La Roche-Posay Effaclar) and a lightweight oil-free moisturizer with SPF 50. I just want to keep the shine under control with a simple routine and not upset my skin.

I don't really know my skin type, since it feels oily some days and normal on others. What I do know is that I have lots of clogged pores and small bumps on my forehead and chin, and I get inflamed pimples several times a month. The skin around my breakouts is red and sore. I tried a tea tree oil spot treatment and a clay mask, but my face turned even redder. I currently use micellar water and a basic moisturizer. Any advice on a routine for congested, pimple-prone skin would help.

My T-zone is very oily, but my cheeks get flaky and feel dehydrated, especially after cleansing. I have clogged pores and blackheads on my nose, and old dark marks on my cheeks and temples. I also have sensitivity to fragrance and essential oils: perfumed creams and some sunscreens make my face itch and burn. I use a salicylic acid cleanser and a gel-cream moisturizer, but I think the cleanser is drying out my cheeks. I'd like a fragrance-free routine to help with all this.

My skin is normal, not too oily or dry, and generally comfortable. Recently I've had hormonal breakouts along my jaw about a week before my period. The pimples leave dark marks that stay for months, especially on my cheeks. I wash twice a day with a mild cleanser (Cetaphil) and use a basic moisturizer. I tried a retinol serum but stopped because I wasn't sure how to introduce it. I want to clear the pimples and fade the marks.

My skin type is normal overall, but I have lots of issues at once. I get regular breakouts and my pores are clogged with blackheads on my nose and chin. Pimples leave behind dark spots that take ages to fade. My cheeks get red and flushed easily, and in winter some areas turn dry and flaky. I also have an uneven, rough texture on my forehead and some small bumps along my hairline that I can't identify. My routine is a gentle cleanser, a plain moisturizer and occasionally a glycolic acid toner, which stings. Heavy foundations make everything worse.

My skin is oily and shiny all day, but I also have dry, rough patches around my nose and on my cheeks. I get constant breakouts, with blackheads and clogged pores on my nose and chin, and the pimples leave red marks and dark spots that last for months. My cheeks are often red and irritated. I use a strong foaming cleanser, a benzoyl peroxide cream and a clay mask twice a week, and I suspect I'm over-drying my face. Coconut oil and heavy creams made my pores clog more. I need a simpler routine.

Honestly I have no idea what skin type I am. It's oily in some places, tight in others, and it reacts differently every week. I get pimples on my chin and cheeks, blackheads and clogged pores around my nose, and dark spots from old breakouts. My face is red and blotchy, and some patches are dry and flaky. There is also a rough, bumpy texture on my forehead and a burning sensation after using new products. I've reacted badly to fragrance, alcohol-based toners and a retinol cream. I currently only use water and a basic moisturizer because I'm afraid to try anything new.

I'm 24 and my chin and nose are constantly full of blackheads, plus I get inflamed pimples along my jawline every month. The skin around the breakouts looks red and angry, and the redness stays for days. I also have a strange rough, bumpy texture on my forehead that I can't explain. I use a foaming cleanser from Neutrogena, a salicylic acid toner, and sometimes a clay mask. Benzoyl peroxide 10% made my face burn and peel, so I stopped it.

I think my skin is pretty normal, not too oily or tight, but lately everything seems to be going wrong at once. I have dry flaky patches around my nose and mouth, a few active pimples on my cheeks, clogged pores on my chin, dark marks left over from old breakouts, and redness across my cheeks. I also have a bumpy texture on my upper arms and forehead. My routine is CeraVe hydrating cleanser, The Ordinary niacinamide, and Eucerin moisturizer. Fragrance-heavy creams make my cheeks flush, and a glycolic acid peel caused a lot of stinging.

I honestly don't know my skin type. Some days it feels oily and other days tight. My main problems are persistent redness on my cheeks and around my nose, and clogged pores with blackheads on my nose and chin. I use a gentle Cetaphil cleanser and a basic moisturizer. Scrubs and physical exfoliators make the redness much worse and my face feels hot afterward. Retinol made my skin flush and sting, so I stopped it.

My skin is very dry, especially in winter, and it feels tight right after washing. Despite that I keep getting painful pimples on my cheeks and jaw, probably because I use heavy creams. The dry patches flake around the pimples, and acne treatments dry me out even more. I use La Roche-Posay Toleriane cleanser and Vaseline on the dry spots. Benzoyl peroxide and alcohol-based toners make my skin crack and peel, so I avoid them.

I'm 29 and have been struggling with clogged pores on my nose and forehead, recurring pimples, and dark marks that stay for months after a breakout heals. I also have small bumps under the skin on my temples and some ingrown hairs along my jaw where I shave. My routine is a salicylic acid cleanser, Paula's Choice BHA twice a week, and a light gel moisturizer. Coconut oil broke me out badly, and I'm not sure about heavy sunscreens either.

I'm 38 and mostly worried about fine lines around my eyes and uneven skin texture, along with dark spots on my cheeks from sun exposure and some melasma-like patches on my upper lip. My skin also feels dry and flaky, especially around my mouth. My routine is just micellar water and a Nivea cream. Fragrance in creams gives me itchy eyelids, and I'd like to start using vitamin C and sunscreen but I'm worried about irritation.

My T-zone gets shiny by midday and is full of clogged pores and blackheads, while my cheeks feel dry and flaky. I also get pimples around my chin and forehead, especially before my period. I use a gel cleanser, a salicylic acid serum on my nose, and a rich cream on my cheeks. Heavy oils clog my forehead, but light lotions do nothing for the dry patches. Harsh clay masks leave my cheeks peeling.

I really can't tell what my skin type is, because it changes every week. I have dry, flaky patches on my cheeks, redness around my nose, inflamed acne on my chin and jaw, clogged pores, and stubborn dark spots from old pimples. I also get a lot of sensitivity and burning with new products, and my skin looks dull and uneven. I use a mild Avène cleanser, a moisturizer, and occasionally a vitamin C serum. Fragrance, essential oils, and strong AHAs have all caused stinging and rashes.

My skin is generally normal, not oily and not dry, but I have a few recurring problems. I get small pimples on my chin, clogged pores on my nose, red blotchy cheeks after exercise or when I'm stressed, and dark marks that linger after breakouts. I also have visible large pores and uneven texture on my cheeks. I use a gentle gel cleanser, niacinamide serum, and SPF 50 daily. A strong retinol cream made my cheeks red and irritated, and a pore-strip habit has made my nose worse.

I have no idea if my skin is oily or dry, it feels both depending on the day. I have acne on my cheeks and forehead, blackheads and clogged pores, red irritated patches, dry flaky areas, dark spots from past pimples, and some rough bumps on my skin that I can't identify. My routine is Cetaphil cleanser, a drugstore spot treatment, and sometimes a sheet mask. Products with alcohol and heavy fragrance make my skin red, and tea tree oil gave me a bad rash.

I'm 24 and my skin gets shiny by midday, especially on my forehead and nose. I have inflamed breakouts on my cheeks and jawline, and after they heal they leave dark marks that last for months. The skin around the pimples stays red and irritated. I currently use a CeraVe foaming cleanser morning and night and The Ordinary Niacinamide serum. I tried a benzoyl peroxide 10% gel and it left my face very red and peeling, so I stopped. I would like a gentle routine that calms the redness and fades the marks.

My skin is very oily, I have to blot it several times a day and my makeup slides off by lunchtime. I don't really have any specific problems like breakouts or marks, I just want to control the shine. I use La Roche-Posay Effaclar gel cleanser and a light gel moisturizer from Neutrogena. Heavy creams make me feel greasy, so I'm looking for a mattifying routine that won't make my face feel tight.

My skin feels tight and flaky all year, especially on my cheeks and around my nose. The red patches get worse in winter and when I use hot water. I use Cetaphil gentle cleanser and Eucerin Urea cream, but my face still burns a bit after washing. Fragranced products and anything with alcohol make my cheeks flush bright red. I need a very soothing and hydrating routine.

My cheeks get dry and flaky while my T-zone gets oily. I also get random itchy rashes near my mouth and eyelids whenever I try new products, and I think I react to fragrance and lanolin. I use Avene Tolerance cleanser and a light Vichy moisturizer. I have had bad reactions to a vitamin C serum from Garnier and a lavender-scented cream. I need help with dryness and these sensitivity reactions.

I have combination skin: oily on the forehead and nose but dry and tight on my cheeks, especially after cleansing. My cheeks sometimes flake under makeup. I use a foaming cleanser from Garnier and a Nivea day cream, but it doesn't seem enough for the dry areas. I would like to add hydration, maybe hyaluronic acid, without making my T-zone greasier.

My skin is generally balanced, neither too oily nor too dry, but I get occasional breakouts around my chin and the marks they leave behind take a long time to fade. My cheeks also get red easily after exercise or when I use scrubs. I use Bioderma Sensibio gel and a simple Neutrogena Hydro Boost moisturizer. A salicylic acid toner from Paula's Choice made me red and stingy, so I stopped using it. I want something to prevent breakouts and fade the dark spots.

I honestly can't tell what my skin type is, it feels oily in some places and dry in others depending on the week. My cheeks are red and blotchy, I have dark spots from old sun exposure, and my skin feels dry and rough after washing. I also have a strange bumpy texture on my forehead and little itchy patches near my hairline that come and go. I use a micellar water and whatever moisturizer I have around. Scented lotions and retinol from The Ordinary made my skin burn badly.

My skin is very dry and often feels rough. I have dark spots on my cheeks and upper lip from melasma after pregnancy, and I also have fine lines and some sensitivity around my eyes that I'd like to take care of. I use Aveeno Calm and Restore moisturizer and a gentle cream cleanser from CeraVe. Glycolic acid peels made my skin peel and sting, so I avoid strong exfoliants. I need a nourishing routine with sunscreen and gentle brightening.

I'm not sure what my skin type is, but I have constant breakouts on my forehead and chin, and my pores are clogged with blackheads on my nose. I currently wash with a basic soap-free cleanser and sometimes use pore strips. A scrub from St. Ives made the acne much worse and irritated my skin. I want a routine for the acne and the clogged pores.

My skin is normal most of the time, but I get red, inflamed pimples around my cheeks and chin before my period and the skin around them stays red for days. I use Simple Kind to Skin cleanser and a light moisturizer with SPF. Toothpaste on pimples (an old habit) made my skin very irritated, and I've learned to avoid harsh spot treatments. I want a gentle routine to calm the redness and manage the occasional acne.

I have very oily skin that is shiny by midday, but my main problem is the dark spots on my cheeks and forehead. They appeared after a summer at the beach and have not faded in over a year. I currently use a gel cleanser from CeraVe and a light mattifying moisturizer. I use SPF 30 only occasionally, and I know that is probably making the spots worse. I have no known allergies and nothing has ever caused a reaction. I want something to fade the spots without making my skin greasier.

My skin feels tight and rough, especially after showering and during winter. I have flaky patches around my nose and on my cheeks. I have honestly never figured out what my skin type is. I just wash with whatever bar soap is in the bathroom and sometimes put on body lotion. Foaming cleansers make the tightness worse. I don't have breakouts or discoloration, I just want my skin to feel comfortable and hydrated.

I'm 45 and my skin is combination, with a shiny T-zone and normal cheeks. I have fine lines around my eyes and mouth, and a few brown spots on my temples from years of sun exposure. My routine is a gentle cleanser, a vitamin C serum in the morning and a basic moisturizer at night. Retinol made my skin peel, so I stopped using it. I'd like a routine that targets the lines and the spots without irritation.

My skin is oily on the forehead and nose but dry on the cheeks, which often feel tight by evening. I also have very sensitive skin that stings when I use products with fragrance, and fragranced body lotions have given me itchy rashes before. On top of that I have sun spots on my cheeks and upper lip. I currently use La Roche-Posay Toleriane cleanser and a fragrance-free moisturizer. I'm looking for hydration and gentle spot-fading ingredients that won't cause stinging.

My skin is a mess right now. My T-zone is oily with blackheads and clogged pores on my nose and chin, while my cheeks are dry and flaky. I get inflamed pimples along my jawline every month, and they leave dark marks that last for months. My cheeks are often red and blotchy, and I think my skin is also a bit sensitive in general. I've tried benzoyl peroxide, which dried me out and made the redness worse, and a salicylic acid toner, which stung. Coconut oil broke me out badly. I use a basic foaming cleanser and a drugstore moisturizer, and I want one routine that deals with everything.

My skin is very oily and I get constant breakouts and clogged pores, so for years I have used harsh scrubs, alcohol toner and strong acne treatments. Now my skin is red and irritated, and I have dry flaky patches around my mouth and cheeks even though it is still greasy. The pimples leave dark marks that linger. I also think my skin barrier is damaged, because everything stings, including plain moisturizer. Benzoyl peroxide and high-percentage glycolic acid caused burning and peeling. I want to repair my skin and still manage the acne.

I honestly don't know my skin type. Some days it's greasy and some days it's normal. I have blackheads and clogged pores on my nose, red inflamed pimples on my chin and cheeks, and dark marks left behind by old breakouts. My cheeks are also red most of the time, especially after exercise or when I use exfoliants. I use a random face wash from the supermarket and a moisturizer. Scrub products made my redness much worse. I'd like help to figure out a simple routine.

I have combination skin with an oily T-zone and normal cheeks. I get pimples on my forehead and chin, plus lots of clogged pores and blackheads around my nose. I use a salicylic acid cleanser from Neutrogena and a gel moisturizer, and I sometimes use a clay mask. It helps a bit, but I keep getting new breakouts every week. Heavy creams and oils make the clogged pores worse. I don't have any known allergies, and I don't have redness or dryness.

I'm not sure if my skin is dry or oily because it changes with the seasons. My main concerns are persistent puffiness and dark circles under my eyes, and some dark patches on my upper lip and cheeks that have gotten darker during pregnancy. Eye creams with fragrance make my eyelids itch and swell. I only use micellar water and a basic moisturizer right now. I'd like gentle suggestions that are safe and effective for these areas.

My skin is oily, and it's shiny by lunchtime, especially on my forehead and nose. Other than that I don't have any real problems. I don't get breakouts or redness, and my skin isn't dry or marked. I just want a simple, lightweight routine to keep it balanced and keep the shine under control. Right now I wash with a gel cleanser morning and night and use an oil-free moisturizer with SPF in the morning. I have no allergies and haven't reacted badly to any product.

I'm 34 and I've had stubborn dark marks on my cheeks since a sun trip two summers ago. My skin also feels tight and flaky, especially around the mouth and on my cheeks after washing. I'm not sure what my skin type is because it feels dry in some places and normal in others. I currently use a foaming cleanser, a basic CeraVe moisturizer and sometimes sunscreen. I'd like a routine that fades the marks without drying me out more.

I honestly have no idea what my skin type is. I get red patches around my nose and cheeks, and the skin on my forehead gets dry and rough. I have breakouts on my chin and jawline, and they leave dark marks that last for months. I also have a lot of fine lines and sensitivity around my eyes, and my skin stings when I use a new product. I use micellar water, a Neutrogena spot treatment and a random night cream. Salicylic acid made my dryness and redness much worse.

My skin is on the dry side, but my main problem is clogged pores. I have little bumps on my forehead and tiny blackheads on my nose that never seem to go away. I use a gentle cream cleanser, Cetaphil lotion and a hyaluronic acid serum. I'm afraid heavy creams make the clogging worse. I'd like something that unclogs my pores without stripping my skin.

My skin is a mess and I can't describe it with one word. It's dry and flaky in some areas, with clogged pores and blackheads on my nose and chin. I get red, inflamed pimples on my cheeks, and after they heal I'm left with dark spots. I also have an itchy rash near my hairline that I think is a reaction to hair products. I've tried benzoyl peroxide, which caused burning and peeling, and a coconut oil moisturizer, which made my breakouts worse. I'm currently using only water and a gentle bar soap.

I'm 22 and I'm not sure about my skin type. It's oily on my T-zone but the cheeks feel tight and dry. I have constant acne on my forehead and chin, and the old pimples leave dark spots. My pores are clogged with blackheads, and I also have uneven texture and some scarring. I use The Ordinary niacinamide, a foaming wash with salicylic acid and a Neutrogena moisturizer. Retinol gave me a bad reaction with peeling.

My skin is normal, with no breakouts, no dryness and no marks. The only thing that bothers me is persistent redness on my cheeks and around my nose, which gets worse after hot showers or spicy food. My routine is simple: a gentle cleanser, a light moisturizer and SPF 50 daily. I'd like to calm the redness and avoid anything that irritates it, since fragranced products make it flare up.

My skin is normal overall, but lately I've had a lot of issues. I get regular pimples on my chin and cheeks that leave dark marks, and my pores are clogged with blackheads on my nose. Some patches feel dry and rough, and I have sensitivity and itchy skin when the weather changes. I use La Roche-Posay Effaclar gel, a simple moisturizer and sunscreen. Fragrance-heavy toners cause a burning reaction, so I avoid them.

I'm not sure what my skin type is, and I don't really have any specific problems. I'd just like to start a basic skincare routine and find out what suits me. At the moment I only wash my face with water and sometimes use a body lotion on it. I haven't had any bad reactions to products so far, so I'd like simple recommendations.

I can't tell my skin type, but I have a lot going on. There's redness around my nose and cheeks, and frequent acne on my chin with clogged pores and blackheads on my forehead.
